{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Independent Republican Party (Spanish: \"Partido Republicano Independiente\" ) was a political party in Cuba, led by Juan Gualberto Gómez.","title":"Independent Republican Party (Cuba)"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It was formed around 1900, after splits in the Republican parties in Havana, Matanzas and Las Villas.","title":"Independent Republican Party (Cuba)"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The split was caused by the opposition of the Republican parties to Gualberto Gómez's radical position against the Platt Amendment.","title":"Independent Republican Party (Cuba)"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The Independent Republican Party supported Gualberto Gómez's position on the issue.","title":"Independent Republican Party (Cuba)"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The War of Independence of Cuba started on 24 February 1895, under the intellectual leadership of the writer and philosopher José Martí, often called Father of the Country in Cuba.","title":"Saturnino and Mariano Lora"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Martí gave the order to start the Revolution on that date, which started simultaneously in four places—in Bayate, under Bartolomé Masó; in Ibarra, under Juan Gualberto Gómez and Antonio López Coloma; in Baire, with the brothers Saturnino and Mariano Lora and their uncle Mariano Torres Mora; and in Guantánamo, with Periquito Pérez, Emilio Giró and others.","title":"Saturnino and Mariano Lora"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" 24 February is commemorated in Cuba as a national holiday under the name \"Grito de Baire\" (\"Shout of Baire\").","title":"Saturnino and Mariano Lora"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Saturnino Lora Civil Hospital is named after Saturnino.","title":"Saturnino and Mariano Lora"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer","Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"Juan Gualberto Gómez has ancestry that is traced to what continent?"}
